subject: Post-call: Cost model & procurement thresholds — token rate bands
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara@healthspan.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cost model & procurement thresholds — token rate bands

Lara / HealthSpan team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the concrete asks we agreed to: 

What we discussed (summary)
- Expected steady-state token profile: 10M–50M tokens/month (conservative to high growth scenario).
- Request: target unit economics to evaluate: $/1M tokens target to justify a self-serve vs reserved decision. You mentioned procurement target of ~ $600–$800 / 1M tokens but want validation.
- Procurement constraints: PO required above a monthly threshold (you mentioned $15k–$25k), and finance wants an itemized quote + term for invoicing cadence.
- Latency/availability: production latency target is p95 < 350ms for chat flows — we'll confirm model selection options that meet this.

Immediate asks I’ll action and deliver by EOD tomorrow
1) Two pricing scenarios (hosted, usage-based per 1M token unit price) with monthly spend bands mapped to your 10/25/50M token breakpoints.
2) One reserved/dedicated option with commit tiers (monthly commit, expected $/1M token equivalence, and PO/contract implications).
3) Itemized quote PDF you can share with procurement (includes payment terms, invoicing cadence, and required PO thresholds).

Quick numbers we discussed on the call (rough, ballpark)
- If we price hosted at $700 / 1M tokens => spend bands approx:
  • 10M tokens = $7,000 / month
  • 25M tokens = $17,500 / month
  • 50M tokens = $35,000 / month
- If procurement wants to cap at $15k/month, that maps to ~21.5M tokens at $700 / 1M.

Next steps / proposed timeline
- I’ll send a short quote + simple usage model CSV (shows per-breakpoint math) and a one-page comparison: hosted vs reserved.
- If procurement needs a PO threshold at $20k/month or more, we’ll flag the dedicated path as the simpler contractual route; otherwise usage-based hosted should work with monthly invoices.

Attachments: redwood-quote-healthspan-Q2.pdf (will follow), usage-modeling-sheet.csv

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
On Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 09:18 AM Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sent from my mobile — will expand in the follow-up note.
From: Lara Chen <lara@healthspan.co>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthspan.co>, Jenna Park <jenna@healthspan.co>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost model & procurement thresholds — token rate bands

Thanks Diego — appreciated the call. A couple clarifications from procurement and finance after an internal sync: 

- Procurement notes: our current PO policy requires a PO for any recurring spend > $15,000/month. Above $25,000/month they prefer an annual committed contract. We can flex to a $20k threshold with director approval but would like to avoid surprise escalations.
- Finance asks: can you provide either (A) a month-by-month estimate for 12 months at three adoption curves (slow/medium/aggressive) or (B) an annual committed discount profile for a 12-month reserve? They like a simple projection they can attach to the CAPEX/forecast.
- Legal question: do you have a standard data residency clause? HealthSpan requires logs and audit trail retention for 12 months.

Also: is there a minimum signup lead time for Dedicated? If we go that route we need to know provisioning lead time to align with our Q3 feature launch.

If you can get the quote and the three projections by EOD Thursday that would keep us on schedule for a procurement review next Tuesday.

Lara
Lara Chen
Head of Partnerships, HealthSpan
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara@healthspan.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@healthspan.co>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost model & procurement thresholds — token rate bands

Lara — great questions. Deliverables attached and quick answers inline below; the attached PDF is the official quote you can share with procurement.

Answering your bullets:
- PO threshold: confirmed — monthly usage invoices work for hosted until $15k/month without a PO; between $15k–$25k we’ll accept a monthly PO; above $25k we recommend a reserved commitment (Dedicated) to get better unit economics and to satisfy your legal/finance teams. We put those thresholds in the quote.
- Forecasts: attached usage-modeling-sheet.csv includes three curves (slow/medium/aggressive) over 12 months at both hosted and two reserved tiers. Example callouts from the sheet: at the medium curve (25M tokens/month average) hosted @ $700/1M => ~$17.5k/mo; reserved 12-mo commit at 30% discount brings that to ~$12.25k/mo equivalent.
- Data residency & retention: Redwood supports region-specific data controls. We will include a 12-month audit-log retention addendum (we already have a standard clause; Legal can review).
- Dedicated provisioning lead time: typical lead time is 3–4 weeks once contract signed + PO issued. For an expedited path we can prioritize in our queue but would need written signoff on the commit.

Pricing highlights (from the quote PDF) — TL;DR
- Hosted (usage): $700 / 1M tokens (volume tiers available) — monthly invoicing, no minimum, PO accepted above $15k/month.
- Reserved (12-mo commit): equivalent $490 / 1M tokens at a 30% effective discount for a 30M token/month commit. Requires an annual commitment and PO/contract before provisioning.

Attachments included:
- redwood-quote-healthspan-Q2.pdf (itemized quote + terms)
- usage-modeling-sheet.csv (breakpoint math and 12mo curves)

Next steps I propose
1) You confirm which procurement threshold you want to target (monthly hosted path < $15k, hosted with PO at $15k–$25k, or reserved commit > $25k).
2) If reserved, I’ll loop in Solutions Engineering to nail the latency/p95 numbers and produce an SOW appendix.
3) If hosted, we’ll prepare an invoice template and sample monthly usage email for your finance team.

DocuSign: I’ve pre-populated the quote and can send a DocuSign link once you confirm the path.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-quote-healthspan-Q2.pdf; usage-modeling-sheet.csv
From: Lara Chen <lara@healthspan.co>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@healthspan.co>, Jenna Park <jenna@healthspan.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cost model & procurement thresholds — token rate bands

Diego — thanks, received the quote and the modeling sheet. Quick internal notes:

- Procurement prefers we aim for the reserved commit to keep unit costs predictable; they want to run the medium curve through finance and see the long-term P&L. Please go ahead and loop in Solutions Engineering and Legal.
- Finance asked that the DocuSign bundle include a sample monthly invoice and the audit-log retention addendum.
- We’ll aim for a procurement call next Tue (Apr 20) at 10am PT — I’ll send the invite once I confirm availability with the Director.

Action items for you:
- Send the DocuSign link with the reserved 12-mo commit option (HS-2027-042) and include the invoice template + retention addendum.
- Loop in SE (+ latency SLO notes) and Legal.

I’ll bring Procurement and Finance to the Tue call.

Thanks — Lara
Lara Chen
Head of Partnerships, HealthSpan
